tukey_cutoffs.note_verbatim: Note: If the calculated lower or upper outer fence exceeds the minimum or maximum range of the measure, then the minimum or maximum measure score is shown in the table. This means that no outliers were identified at that end of the measure score range. For D04 (decline) group, the upper cut off is technically the lowest value below zero since zero is included in the D04 (improved) group.

pre_guardrail_thresholds.note_verbatim: Notes: These are not the final thresholds for the 2024 Star Ratings. See the Measure Details section for final thresholds after guardrails have been applied.
pre_guardrail_thresholds.semantics: Mean resampling estimated thresholds AFTER Tukey outlier deletion, BEFORE guardrails. For higher-is-better rows the four cut points are the 'lo' of star levels 2-5; for lower-is-better rows they are the 'hi' of star levels 2-5.

final_thresholds_source.statement: Final (post-guardrail) per-measure cut points are stated in each measure's 'Cut Points:' table in the Measure Details section (Tech Notes pp. 36-110). They are not tabulated compactly in one place in the PDF; the machine-readable source of record is the Star Ratings Data Tables CSVs.

final_thresholds_source.caution: 2024 has TWO published cut-point sets: the October 2023 original (guardrails based on rerun-with-Tukey 2023 cut points, Tables K-7/K-8) and the July 2024 recalculation (guardrails based on the PUBLISHED 2023 cut points, per the court-ordered recalculation; see 2025 Tech Notes 'Note on References to the 2024 Star Ratings'). The Tech Notes Measure Details tables correspond to the October 2023 original.

final_vs_pre_guardrail_check.method: string-exact comparison of K-3/K-4 values against the published final Cut Points CSVs (with '>=100' == '=100' on 0-100 scales)
final_vs_pre_guardrail_check.reading: EQUAL means guardrail did not change that measure's cut points (either exempt or non-binding); a dict means guardrails moved at least one cut point.

anomalies: K-4 D02 MA-PD 2 Stars printed as 'less than 0.6 to 1' in the 03/13/2024 PDF; the 09/29/2023 first release prints '> 0.6 to <= 1'. Interpreted as greater-than (matches C25 which shares the distribution shape). Typo introduced in the revision.
K-7 C28 5 Stars and K-8 D01 PDP 5 Stars: final PDF prints 'equal to 100%', first release prints '>= 100 %'. Semantically identical on a 0-100 percent scale.
K-7/K-8 print lower-is-better interior ranges in descending orientation (e.g. 'greater than 0.68 to 0.43' = (0.43, 0.68]); entries normalized with flag descending_notation_normalized.

K-7/K-8 row labels are 2024-vintage measure IDs (despite the table titles saying '2023 Star Ratings ... Thresholds'): membership is exactly the set of 2024 guardrailed measures (all non-CAHPS, non-improvement, non-new 2024 measures; C11/C15/C17/C18/C27 and D04/D07 absent), and values line up with the 2024 K-3 neighbors (e.g. K-7 C14 base 43/57/69/82 + 5pp cap reproduces the published C14 final cut points 38/52/68/82 exactly).
K-6 D04 (decline) MA-PD lower cutoff is printed with SEVEN decimals: -0.7343755 (all other improvement cutoffs have 6 or fewer). Verbatim preserved.

guardrail_basis_thresholds.semantics: Rerun 2023 Star Ratings cut points (mean resampling + Tukey outlier deletion, no guardrails) used as the guardrail base for the ORIGINAL October 2023 release of the 2024 Star Ratings. Row labels are 2024-vintage measure IDs; the tables contain exactly the 2024 guardrailed measures (guardrail-exempt 2024 measures C11, C15, C17, C18, C27, D04, D07 have no row - the absence of C11 is direct documentary proof that Controlling Blood Pressure had no guardrail base in 2024). The July 2024 recalculation instead used the published 2023 Star Ratings cut points as guardrail base.
guardrail_basis_thresholds.verbatim_basis_quote: For the purposes of calculating the guardrails for the 2024 Star Ratings, the 2023 Star Ratings cut points were rerun including mean resampling, Tukey outlier deletion and no guardrails. These rerun 2023 Star Ratings cut points serve as the basis for applying the guardrails for the 2024 Star Ratings and are shown in Tables K-7 and K-8.
